GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok going Through Soon After settled down third fence trailing Leader 2 Lengths (1000m), same to turn now urged though, angling Clear 200, trying hard couldn't get past the winner hwoever # beat rest clearly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up for a run passing the 500m until passing the 400m. When under pressure in the home straight laid in.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 6.5 Lengths Two Wide , Made Some Ground to 5.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, made a little ground in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly early stages.] # never a real threat

Jumped okay & Settled Down 2nd 3 Lengths on fence, shifted Two Wide at 1050m, Moved Up to 3 Wide joint Lead at 700m, in Two Wide 550m, led Two Wide jointly turning, narrowly Headed Straightening Up , raced neck'n'neck to the post. [Stewards: raced keenly early stages.] # lost in headbobber
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle. Near the 1300m whilst over racing shifted out. Shortly afterwards steadied from heels. Continued to over race until the passing the 900m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , enjoyed rails trail behind Leader 2 Lengths 800m, gap opened on the turn hard on fence when Leader rolled off, burst Through and took over at 200m, kept his head high and held margin, challenged on line but held on for close win # rail hugging win
Little Slow Out Restrained thus Settled Down 5th Inside 4 1/2 Lengths and Inside the winner, held-up @ 600m into Clear Turning for home railed kept trying without threatening - # Even Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Vetted pre-race after having raced 11/7/26. Raced keenly in the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well off a rails gate settled down fourth fence tracking Leader 3 Lengths (1400m), margin 5 Lengths 1000 as new Leader Took over, urged along 500, cornered closer with a gap & now picking up, couldn't match them late (Blinkers OFF AGAIN) # did have chance

Jumped Ok Ridden Along Went Forward Took sit Run Of Race 3rd Inside 2 Lengths looked a bit keen then was Hard Ridden x 400m couldn't finish off 1st sat 2nd 1st 2 out 1st 2 home , this had its chance - # had all favours

Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths on fence, held together much same to turn the kept trying but lost a length in straight. (Blinkers AGAIN, Winkers OFF AGAIN) [Stewards: Raced keenly early/middle stages.] # Had Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out when racing keenly and close to heels near 1300m. Raced keenly in the early and middle stages. When placed under pressure in the home straight, laid in.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 5 Lengths Two Wide , Hooked Out 3-4 Wide at 700m, Restrained off heels 500m, made no actual ground to 5 Lengths Four Wide turning, widest in Straight and kept coming in the run to the line. [Stewards: Raced keenly middle stages. Jockey reported it had a tendency to lay in throughout.] # Wide last 700m
Jumped okay & Settled Down 1.5 Lengths Two Wide , moved to within 0.75 Lengths turning, hit Lead 100m, Headed 75m, kept battling to post # battled on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3rd trailing 5 Lengths Two Wide , Moved Up to 2.5 Lengths rail turning, kept making gradual ground in Straight # battled on ok
Jumped Ok , sat on Leaders heels Two Wide 1 Lengths 1000m, took over before the corner but hard ridden, fought tenaciously last 100m and proved too smart # tough on pace win
